q: Sofic entropy is defined using approximating maps σᵢ: G → Sym(nᵢ). The entropy of a partition depends on counting good models; a key feature is that it can be:
opts: −∞ (undefined/minus infinity) for some actions, unlike KS entropy which is always ≥ 0
exp: One subtlety of sofic entropy: it can equal −∞ (essentially undefined) for some actions of non-amenable groups. This indicates the action cannot be approximated in the sofic framework, a phenomenon absent in the amenable case.
